scripts.dev: concurrently -n be,fe -c blue,green "cd backend && uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000" "pnpm --filter fullstack-frontend dev"
scripts.test: cd backend && python3 -m pytest app/tests/ -v && cd .. && pnpm --filter fullstack-frontend test
scripts.lint: cd backend && ruff check . && cd .. && pnpm --filter fullstack-frontend lint
scripts.fmt: cd backend && ruff format . && cd .. && pnpm --filter fullstack-frontend fmt
